data.description:
## Context / Problem
A single Gerrit Verified run needs 21 concurrent job slots against a GitHub Free org-wide cap of 20 total / 5 macOS, shared with every other navapbc repo. `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` contributes 8 of those, and one of them does no unique work.

The `import-linter` job installs `-e .[dev]` — byte-identical to `_build-and-test.yml:230` — and runs `pytest tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py tests/unit/test_optional.py`. Those files carry NO pytest markers, and tests/conftest.py only auto-marks `external` under `tests/external/`, so all 9 tests already run in all four `test` matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS) — strictly more coverage than this job single ubuntu/3.12 run.

The "import-leak test defeated by a polluted worker process" concern does NOT apply here, which is why the deletion is safe: `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` reads `sys.modules` inside a FRESHLY SPAWNED `subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code])`; `test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` is a pure `ast.parse` walk over source; and `test_blocked_extra_degrades_friendly` uses the `block_extra` fixture, which EVICTS modules from `sys.modules` and is therefore STRONGER in a loaded worker, not weaker. There is no `COVERAGE_PROCESS_START`/`sitecustomize` in the repo, so even the coverage lane child is a bare interpreter.

## Approach
Delete the job — and repay, in the same change, the guard it was incidentally providing.

THE GAP THIS OPENS: nothing in the repo can see the deletion. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:131-162` asserts only caller-level WIRING strings (that gerrit-verify invokes the reusable, passes the refspec, that `vote.needs` contains `optionality`). `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:44-51` reads only caller job keys. NEITHER has any visibility into `_optionality.yml` inner jobs, so both pass unchanged after the deletion.

That means once the dedicated job is gone, the ONLY thing keeping those 9 tests running is the incidental fact that the two files carry no marker. A future contributor who adds `@pytest.mark.integration`, moves the files, or adds a `paths:` filter deletes the optionality guard with a fully GREEN build. Given this project already has a history of an optionality gap letting bugs reach main, shipping the deletion without a replacement guard is not acceptable.

So the deletion is paired with a durable, checked-in test asserting those two files are still collected by the default suite selection.

Rejected alternative: keep the job. It costs a slot against a cap the run already exceeds, for coverage the matrix strictly dominates.
Rejected alternative: delete without the guard. That converts an explicit check into an implicit one with no alarm.

## Scope
- `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml` — remove the `import-linter` job only. No other job is touched.
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` — add the collection guard.

NOT in scope: the per-extra/union collapse (separate ticket ad63-17ad-d545-45d4), `clean-core-wheel`, `_build-and-test.yml`.

## Testing
The guard must be durable rather than a one-time check, because the risk is a future edit, not this change.

Add a test that runs pytest collection over the two files with the default suite selection (`-m "not integration and not external"`) and asserts 9 items are collected. Collecting by running the real selection — rather than grepping for marker text — is what makes it catch a marker added anywhere: file-level `pytestmark`, a decorator, or a conftest-applied mark.

The only real loss from the deletion is diagnostic latency: a heavy-import regression currently reddens a ~1 min job and afterwards surfaces inside a ~15 min matrix cell. That is accepted and recorded here deliberately.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `import-linter` job no longer exists in `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`.
- [ ] No other job in that file is modified.
- [ ] A checked-in test asserts `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` and `tests/unit/test_optional.py` collect 9 items under `-m "not integration and not external"`.
- [ ] That test FAILS if a marker excluding either file from the default selection is added.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` passes.
- [ ] `make lint` passes (actionlint covers all workflows).
data.title: Delete the redundant import-linter job and repay its guard with a collection test
